title: Model Evaluation & Validation
why: A model you cannot evaluate honestly is a liability. Interviewers probe this constantly because real projects fail here.
explain: Never judge a model on data it trained on. Split into train, validation and test: tune on validation, report once on test. With small data use k-fold cross-validation, rotating which fold is held out and averaging the scores; stratify so each fold keeps the class ratios.

Pick metrics that match the goal. Precision = TP / (TP + FP) says how many alerts are right; recall = TP / (TP + FN) says how many true cases you catch; F1 is their harmonic mean. ROC-AUC measures ranking quality across thresholds, and PR-AUC is more informative when positives are rare. For regression use MAE, RMSE and R-squared.

Watch for overfitting (training score far above validation), leakage (validation suspiciously good) and distribution shift (production data differs from training). Always compare against a trivial baseline, and use learning curves to tell whether you need more data or a better model.
key_points: Precision vs recall is a trade-off you set with the threshold
Learning curves diagnose underfitting vs overfitting
pitfalls: Tuning hyperparameters on the test set

leetcode.why: Rolling averages over a window are how you monitor a metric over time.
Maintaining a running median with two heaps is how latency percentiles are tracked on streams.
Top-k by score is the retrieval and ranking evaluation primitive.
Selecting the k most frequent items shows up when you analyze errors by category.
Point-in-time lookups prevent leakage: you may only use values known at prediction time.

industry.q: Explain precision versus recall with an example where you would optimize each.
key_points: Precision when false alarms are expensive, such as auto-blocking accounts
Recall when misses are expensive, such as cancer screening
The threshold moves you along the trade-off
F-beta or a cost matrix can combine them

industry.q: Offline AUC is 0.92 but online performance is poor. List possible causes.
key_points: The metric does not match the business KPI

industry.q: How would you evaluate a model trained on time-ordered data?
key_points: Split by time or use walk-forward validation
No features computed with future information
Leave a gap when labels arrive late
Report performance per period to catch drift
